title: HepatiQ: Explainable Clinical Risk Prediction for Primary Biliary Cholangitis
description: HepatiQ is an academic research prototype for explainable 5-year severe-event risk estimation in primary biliary cholangitis. It combines a leakage-safe logistic-regression pipeline, SHAP attributions, a FastAPI service, a Streamlit interface, batch CSV scoring, and a published-score benchmark. Research use only; not a medical device.
